The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
This creamy mushroom-and-vegetable soup is thick and flavorful.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Cream of Mushroom Soups are made by [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]], [[Fresh Milk]], [[Rock Salt]], and any vegetable, herb, or flower in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Regular Cream of Mushroom Soup is made by either using Ingredients without any effects or using two Ingredients with contradictory effects. Eating one restores four [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]. They are worth 30 [[Rupee]]s when sold. These soups are known to be so chunky that they're as filling as a full meal. Several different variations of Cream of Mushroom Soups exist, depending on the type of Ingredients used: * '''Hearty Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Truffle]]s, [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they completely restore all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum hearts. They also sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Energizing Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Stamella Shroom]]s or other stamina-increasing Ingredients. Eating one will refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They restore seven of his Hearts and they sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Enduring Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Endura Shroom]]s or [[Endura Carrot]]s. Consuming this soup will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. They heal for five Hearts and sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Hasty Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Rushroom]]s or other speed-increasing Ingredients. These soups will temporarily increase Link's speed when eaten. They also restore four Hearts to Link, and they sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Spicy Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Sunshroom]]s or other heat-related Ingredients. Eating one will temporarily grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. They also heal him for four Hearts, but are worth 30 Rupees when sold. * '''Electro Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Zapshroom]]s or other electricity-related Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]] for a short time. They also heal four of his Hearts and sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Mighty Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Razorshroom]]s or other attack-increasing Ingredients. These soups increase Link's attack power when consumed. They restore four Hearts to Link and sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Tough Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Ironshroom]]s or other defensive Ingredients. Eating one will temporarily increase Link's defense. They replenish four Hearts, and they sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Sneaky Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Grants a mid-level stealth boost.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Silent Shroom]]s or other sneaky Ingredients. Consuming this soup increases Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period. They heal four of Link's Hearts and sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Chilly Cream of Mushroom Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The creamy mushroom and vegetable soup is so chunky it eats like a meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Chillshroom]]s or other cold Ingredients. When eaten, these soups will increase Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level temporarily. They heal four of Link's Hearts, but they can also be sold for 30 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Cream of Mushroom Soup reappears in {{TotK}}. It has the same [[Recipe]] from {{BotW}}, which involves [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]] with [[Fresh Milk]], [[Rock Salt]], and any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cream of Vegetable Soup * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Soups |items= BotW, TotK }}
